featured_reviews.name: Vinod Lakhani
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are from Marketing, Sales, Customer Relations or any field related to Business Development & you need to learn skills, especially if you need to learn WHAT NOT TO DO in your field, then a visit to Viva Honda Cars Showroom at Santacruz is highly recommended.

Mis-selling, false promises, absolute apathy for schedules, not receiving calls or answering messages, cold responses, no regard for commitments - all this I had to face when I bought a Honda car recently from Viva Honda, Santacruz.

1. To close the deal immediately, the Sales Executive went overboard and promised me 5 accessory items as freebies. He wrote only 2 of the freebies on the Booking Contract form. When I asked him pointedly why he was not listing all 5 freebies, he said that he will give them to me for sure, but due to some Company policy he cannot write it down. Biggest mistake I made in trusting a reputed Dealer's Sales Executive and taking his word for honesty.This particular Dealer is very reputed and he owns more than a dozen dealerships and service centres of various car companies. In fact my last car - a Hyundai - was purchased from a group Company of this very same Dealer more than 10 years ago and for this entire period all my services and repairs were done at the same Dealer's Authorized Hyundai workshop.
2. Now coming back to my Honda car purchase, on the day of delivery, only the 2 accessories mentioned in the Booking form were fitted. The other 3 accessories were never given - even after repeated reminders and escalating the matter to the Sales Head and the Customer Relations Executive and CRM Manager.  The reply was very blunt - what is written is what we will give. My plea that I was promised all this and that you can cross-check with the Sales Executive just fell on deaf ears. Even the Sales Executive said that yes he had promised, but can't do anything now.
3. After making payment for the car, I was promised that delivery will be given on a particular Thursday. When there was no news from the Team on delivery, I messaged one day prior on Wednesday as to when I should come to take delivery the next day. That is when the Sales Head casually writes that the delivery will be given next week as Registration work is pending. Imagine the shock. Nonchalantly the Sales Head writes that delivery will be next week. This is after full payment has already been made and that too 5 days prior. Then after a lot of cajoling, trying to talk sense to them and finally vetting out my frustration, they managed to give delivery on Saturday - 2 days later than scheduled and ofcourse without the 3 orally promised accessories.
4. Once you have taken car from the Showroom, then you are totally at the Viva Honda team's mercy. They do not answer calls. They never call back.  Don't reply to messages. I tried calling Sales Executive, Sales Head, CRM Executive and CRM Manager.  No one receives the call and no one replies to messages. And even if they do, they just say that they will get back to me and then just silence.
5. In the Honda Connect App,  my car purchase date is wrongly shown as January 2026, whereas I have purchased car in May 2026. Due to this I am missing out on nearly 4 months of warranty. This is major cause of concern. After following up repeatedly, I was told that correction is not possible as they have taken Consumer benefits and Sales targets in January itself. Is this even legally allowed.
6. Finally, I reached out to Honda Car Company for redressal. They said they will connect me with the Dealer on con-call. Imagine the shock I got when I was told that the Dealer did not answer Honda Car Company's call. Then what kind of chance does an ordinary guy like me stand.

Highly disillusioned with Viva Honda.

Although the car is wonderful and I am enjoying the driving experience, but the entire buying experience has been traumatic. I wonder why Honda Car Company is not carrying out more checks on the Dealer to ensure that they adhere to professionalism. No wonder then that even though Honda Cars are so wonderful, their sales are lagging.
